name: Meditation on Oṃ by its measures (as stated in the Māṇḍūkya)
method_summary: The text states the identification of a, u, m with vaiśvānara, taijasa, prājña and of the fourth as measureless, and gives the fruit of knowing them thus (MU 9–12). It gives no procedure beyond this knowing.
